grades.overall_note: The handling was solid: the agent replied to the landlord, sent the tenant fact-finding questions, recorded the summary-versus-report discrepancy, and kept the human escalation in reserve. It fell short on the key: it never asked for a spare key to be provided and did not treat the lock change as a prompt access or safety issue. It also did not link the dog flap to the tenancy agreement's clauses.
